## Glossary

**agent**  
A Claude session's row in the agents table, id agt_{6hex}[_{label}].

**agent status**  
active, idle or dead; getActiveAgents returns only active.

**agent-liveness**  
Class: deciding an agent is alive or dead, by PID locally or by lease in network mode.

**agent-registry**  
Class: agent records, register/reconnect, getAgent*/updateAgent*, hivemind_register and hivemind_status.

**agent:dead**  
Event the coordinator emits for a dead agent (reason lease_expired in network mode).

**agent:register**  
Event emitted only when a new agent is created.

**context_summary**  
Free-text note of what the agent knows; updateAgentContext.

**coordinator**  
Class: the per-project detached process that sweeps agents every 30 s and hosts the plan watcher.

**coordinator.pid / coordinator.lock**  
Files in the project data dir that keep one coordinator per project.

**ensureCoordinator**  
Spawns the coordinator as a detached bun process unless one runs; called by hivemind_emit.

**getAgentLeaseTtlMs**  
The lease TTL in milliseconds, falling back to 180000 on bad values.

**getCoordinatorStatus**  
Reports whether the coordinator runs and its pid, without starting it.

**grace period**  
New agents get 60 s before PID checks apply (local mode).

**HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS**  
Lease length before an unrefreshed agent is marked dead, default 180.

**HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE**  
Selects lease liveness when 1, true, yes or on; mcp:http sets it.

**hivemind_register**  
Tool that registers the calling agent, reconnecting by session id then PID; executeRegister.

**hivemind_status**  
Tool returning summary, metrics, worktrees, activity and recent events; executeStatus.

**isNetworkLivenessMode**  
Reads HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE and says which liveness mode is on.

**last_seen_at**  
Agent column holding the lease timestamp in network mode.

**local mode**  
Default stdio mode: agents tracked by PID, no heartbeats.

**markAgentDead**  
Sets an agent dead, clears its plan and task, releases claimed/in_progress tasks to pending.

**network mode**  
HTTP mode: agents tracked by last_seen_at lease; PIDs not checked.

**pid**  
Claude's process id (process.ppid) stored on the agent for local liveness.

**reconnect**  
Reusing an existing active agent found by session id, then by PID, instead of creating one.

**runCoordinator**  
The coordinator process body: take the lock, sweep every 30 s, run the plan watcher.

**session_id**  
Claude Code session id stored on the agent; changes on compaction (updateAgentSession).

**touchAgent**  
Renews an agent's last_seen_at and sets it active; called by every tool that names the agent.

## 1. What this Warden covers

Who the agents in a project are and whether they are still alive: the agent registry and the register/status tools, the two liveness modes (PID locally, last_seen_at leases over the network), and the per-project coordinator that sweeps dead agents and releases their tasks.

## 2. The domain

Agents arrive through hivemind_register (executeRegister), called by the SessionStart hook or a tool call: it reconnects by session id (getAgentBySessionId), then by PID (getAgentByPid, followed by updateAgentSession when compaction changed the session id), and only otherwise creates a row with registerAgent and emits agent:register; it also syncs worktrees from git. registerAgent is the bare insert, so new code that admits a session goes through executeRegister. hivemind_status (executeStatus) is the overview agents read first: summary, metrics, worktrees, activity, recent events. The getAgent*/updateAgent* helpers read and update one row; markAgentIdle keeps an agent alive between tasks, unregisterAgent deletes the row outright.

Liveness has two modes, chosen by isNetworkLivenessMode from HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE (1, true, yes, on; startHttpMcpServer sets it). Local mode tracks Claude's PID with a 60 s grace for new agents and no heartbeats; agents without a PID are left alone. Network mode tracks a last_seen_at lease that touchAgent renews on every register, status, events, query, emit and task call naming the agent; an agent older than getAgentLeaseTtlMs (HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS, default 180) is marked dead with reason lease_expired. Either way markAgentDead returns its claimed and in_progress tasks to pending and clears its current plan and task.

The coordinator (runCoordinator in src/coordinator/index.ts) is a detached bun process, one per project, held by coordinator.pid and coordinator.lock in the project data dir. Only ensureCoordinator starts it, and only hivemind_emit calls ensureCoordinator; the SessionStart hook never does. It sweeps every 30 s, emits agent:dead and hosts the plan watcher. Not here: the hook and CLI join (claude-code-integration), serving tools and the HTTP server (mcp-server), task claiming and the plan watcher itself (plans-and-tasks), the event log and hivemind_emit (event-log), worktree sync (git-and-worktrees), agent id format and timestamps (storage-and-primitives).

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **Local PID-based liveness** | stdio sessions on one machine; 60 s grace for new agents | agents in separate containers (use Network lease-based liveness) |

| **isNetworkLivenessMode** | branching code between the two modes | setting the mode (use HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE) |

| **touchAgent** | a new tool call names an agent in network mode | local PID mode, where leases decide nothing |
| **getAgentLeaseTtlMs** | reading the lease length in code | changing it (use HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS) |
| **HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS** | changing the lease from 180 s | local mode, which ignores it |

**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Agent Lifecycle (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Agent Lifecycle

There are two liveness modes, chosen by `HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE` (`1`, `true`, `yes` or `on`; `bun run mcp:http` sets it if unset). See `src/agents/livenessMode.ts`.

- **Local mode (default, stdio):** agents are tracked by their **process ID (PID)**. The diagram below shows this mode.
- **Network mode (HTTP):** agents are tracked by a **lease**. `last_seen_at` is set on register and refreshed by every register, status, events, query, emit and task call that names the agent (`touchAgent`). The coordinator marks an agent dead when `last_seen_at` (or `created_at`) is older than `HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS` (default 180), and emits `agent:dead` with reason `lease_expired`. PIDs are not checked.

Marking an agent dead releases its `claimed` and `in_progress` tasks back to `pending` and clears its current plan and task.

```
SessionStart Hook
       │
       ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│ Register Agent   │  ← stores process.ppid (Claude's PID)
│ with PID         │
└────────┬─────────┘
         │
         ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│ Agent Active     │  ← PID is alive
│                  │
└────────┬─────────┘
         │
         │  Claude session ends
         ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│ Coordinator      │  ← sweeps every 30s
│ detects PID dead │  ← 1-min grace period for new agents
└────────┬─────────┘
         │
         ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│ Agent Marked     │
│ Dead             │
└──────────────────┘
```

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#key-design-decisions -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Key Design Decisions (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Key Design Decisions

1. **PID-based lifecycle locally, leases over the network** - Locally no heartbeats are needed: agents live as long as their process. In network mode each tool call renews the agent's lease.

2. **Coordinator singleton** - One per project, runs forever, minimal overhead.

3. **Session ID lookup** - MCP tools can find agent by Claude's session ID.

4. **Grace period** - New agents get 1 minute before PID checking kicks in (local mode).

5. **Event-based communication** - Agents don't talk directly; they emit/query events.

6. **Plans as living docs** - Plans don't auto-complete; they persist as context. Find work by querying plans with pending tasks.

<!-- unit doc:README.md#how-it-works -->
**Source:** `README.md` § How It Works (in "Hivemind")

#### How It Works

Hivemind supports two lifecycle modes:
- Local mode (stdio): agents are tracked by **PID** and the coordinator marks agents dead when their process exits.
- Network mode (HTTP): agents are tracked by **lease heartbeat** (`last_seen_at`) and the coordinator marks agents dead when lease TTL expires.

Session start registers the agent, then status/events/query/task/emit calls refresh liveness in network mode.

See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) for details.

<!-- unit doc:README.md#server-modes -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Server Modes (in "Hivemind")

#### Server Modes

##### Local mode (default, stdio)

Use this for single-machine/local Claude sessions:

```bash
bun run mcp
```

This preserves the existing MCP stdio behavior and local PID-based lifecycle.

##### Network mode (shared MCP over HTTP)

Use this when multiple containers/processes need to share one hivemind:

```bash
HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN=replace-me \
PORT=8787 \
bun run mcp:http
```

The HTTP endpoint is:

```text
http://0.0.0.0:$PORT/mcp
```

Network mode requires:
- `Authorization: Bearer <HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN>` on MCP HTTP requests
- Lease/heartbeat lifecycle (`last_seen_at`) with TTL sweeping (no PID liveness reliance)

<!-- unit doc:README.md#environment-variables -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Environment Variables (in "Hivemind")

#### Environment Variables

- `HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN`: required for `bun run mcp:http`
- `PORT`: HTTP port for network mode (default `8787`)
- `HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL`: when set in hook/agent environments, session-start register/status calls go to remote MCP instead of local DB logic
- `HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS`: lease TTL for stale-agent sweep in network mode (default `180`)
- `HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE`: liveness mode toggle (`1/true` enables lease-based mode). `mcp:http` enables this automatically.
- `HIVEMIND_BASE`: base directory for project DB/state (defaults to `~/.hivemind`)
- `CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL`: optional label the session-start hook gives the agent (it becomes part of the agent ID)

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#overview -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Overview (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Claude Sessions                         │
├─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┬─────┤
│   Agent 1   │   Agent 2   │   Agent 3   │   Agent N   │ ... │
│  (PID 1234) │  (PID 5678) │  (PID 9012) │             │     │
└──────┬──────┴──────┬──────┴──────┬──────┴─────────────┴─────┘
       │             │             │
       ▼             ▼             ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│        MCP Server (stdio, or HTTP in network mode)           │
│  hivemind_register, hivemind_emit, hivemind_query, etc.     │
└─────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                          │
                          ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    SQLite Database                           │
│  ~/.hivemind/claude_hivemind_{project}/hivemind.db          │
├─────────────┬───────────┬──────────┬──────────┬─────────────┤
│   agents    │  events   │  plans   │  tasks   │  worktrees  │
└─────────────┴───────────┴──────────┴──────────┴─────────────┘
                          ▲
                          │
┌─────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Coordinator (singleton)                   │
│  - Checks agent PIDs (local) or leases (network)             │
│  - Marks dead agents, runs the plan watcher                  │
│  - Runs indefinitely per project                            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#core-components -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Core Components (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Core Components

##### 1. SessionStart Hook (`src/hooks/sessionStart.ts`)
- Runs when Claude starts, resumes or compacts (matchers `startup`, `resume`, `compact`)
- Reads the hook's stdin JSON (`session_id`, `cwd`); the project is the git repo name
- Locally: registers the agent with `process.ppid` (Claude's PID) through `executeRegister`, then reads `executeStatus`
- With `HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL` set (needs `HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN`): calls `hivemind_register` and `hivemind_status` on the remote MCP server instead
- An optional label comes from `CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL`
- Outputs agent info to Claude's context
- Does not start the coordinator (see below)

##### 2. Coordinator (`src/coordinator/index.ts`)
- Singleton per project (`coordinator.pid` and `coordinator.lock` in the project data dir)
- Started as a detached `bun` process by `ensureCoordinator` (`src/coordinator/spawn.ts`), which `hivemind_emit` calls on every emit; nothing else starts it
- Sweeps every 30 seconds
- Local mode: checks if agent PIDs are alive via `process.kill(pid, 0)`, with a 1-minute grace period for new agents; agents without a PID are left alone
- Network mode: marks agents whose lease expired
- Starts the plan watcher
- Runs indefinitely

##### 3. MCP Tools (`src/mcp/tools/`)
Defined once in `src/mcp/core.ts` (`HIVEMIND_TOOL_DEFS`, `executeToolByName`, `createMcpServer`) and served over stdio (`src/mcp/server.ts`) or HTTP (`src/mcp/httpServer.ts`).

- `hivemind_setup` - Initialize project database
- `hivemind_register` - Register agent (reconnects by session ID, then PID)
- `hivemind_emit` - Emit events for other agents
- `hivemind_query` - Query events (by since, plan, agent or branch)
- `hivemind_status` - Get hivemind status
- `hivemind_events` - Get recent events
- `hivemind_claim_task`, `hivemind_start_task`, `hivemind_complete_task` - Task workflow
- `hivemind_worktree_cleanup` - Find and clean up stale worktrees
- `hivemind_reset` - Reset database (delete and recreate schema)

##### 4. HTTP Server (`src/mcp/httpServer.ts`)
- `bun run mcp:http`; listens on `PORT` (default 8787), hostname `0.0.0.0`
- `GET /health` returns `{ ok, mode: 'network', sessions }`
- `/mcp` requires `Authorization: Bearer <HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN>`; each MCP session (`mcp-session-id`) gets its own streamable HTTP transport

##### 5. Database Schema

**agents** - Claude sessions
```sql
id, hex, label, status, pid, session_id, last_seen_at,
current_plan_id, current_task_id, worktree_id,
context_summary, created_at
```

**events** - Communication log
```sql
id, hex, seq, timestamp, agent_id, plan_id, task_id,
worktree_id, branch, event_type, content, metadata
```

**plans** - High-level work items
```sql
id, hex, label, title, description, status, branch,
worktree_id, claude_session_id, created_at, created_by
```

**tasks** - Granular work items within plans
```sql
id, plan_hex, seq, label, plan_id, title, description,
status, branch, worktree_id, claimed_by, claimed_at,
completed_at, outcome, parent_task_id
```

**worktrees** - Git worktrees
```sql
id, hex, label, path, branch, commit_hash, is_main,
status, created_at, last_seen
```

### 4b. Code entries

From the catalog (extracted from the code, described by a model). Each line: **name** `where` [kind] the job it does. Use: canonical usage.

#### Class `agent-registry`
- **executeRegister** `src/mcp/tools/register.ts#executeRegister` [primitive] register the calling agent, record its session and sync git worktrees Use: executeRegister({ project, session_id, pid })
- **executeStatus** `src/mcp/tools/status.ts#executeStatus` [primitive] report active agents, their work and recent events for a project Use: executeStatus({ project })
- **getActiveAgents** `src/agents/getActiveAgents.ts#getActiveAgents` [primitive] list every agent whose status is 'active' in a project database Use: getActiveAgents(db) // Agent[]
- **getAgent** `src/agents/getAgent.ts#getAgent` [primitive] fetch one agent by its id, whatever its status Use: getAgent(db, agentId) // Agent | null
- **getAgentByPid** `src/agents/getAgentByPid.ts#getAgentByPid` [primitive] find the active agent registered for a process id, to reconnect after a session change Use: getAgentByPid(db, process.pid) // Agent | null
- **getAgentBySessionId** `src/agents/getAgentBySessionId.ts#getAgentBySessionId` [primitive] find the active agent for a Claude Code session id, so MCP tools need no agent_id Use: getAgentBySessionId(db, sessionId) // Agent | null
- **markAgentIdle** `src/agents/markAgentIdle.ts#markAgentIdle` [primitive] mark an agent idle: alive but not actively working Use: markAgentIdle(db, agentId) // boolean
- **registerAgent** `src/agents/registerAgent.ts#registerAgent` [primitive] create a new agent record in the hivemind Use: registerAgent(db, { ...input }) // Agent
- **registerTool** `src/mcp/tools/register.ts#registerTool` [primitive] define the hivemind_register tool that registers a Claude agent at session start Use: MCP tool name: hivemind_register
- **statusTool** `src/mcp/tools/status.ts#statusTool` [primitive] define the hivemind_status tool to call first at session start to avoid duplicate work Use: MCP tool name: hivemind_status
- **unregisterAgent** `src/agents/unregisterAgent.ts#unregisterAgent` [primitive] delete an agent record from the hivemind Use: unregisterAgent(db, agentId) // boolean
- **updateAgentContext** `src/agents/updateAgentContext.ts#updateAgentContext` [primitive] store a summary of what an agent knows or is working on Use: updateAgentContext(db, agentId, contextSummary)
- **updateAgentSession** `src/agents/updateAgentSession.ts#updateAgentSession` [primitive] replace an agent's session id after the conversation compacts Use: updateAgentSession(db, agentId, sessionId)
- **updateAgentTask** `src/agents/updateAgentTask.ts#updateAgentTask` [primitive] set the plan and task an agent is currently on Use: updateAgentTask(db, agentId, planId, taskId)
- **updateAgentWorktree** `src/agents/updateAgentWorktree.ts#updateAgentWorktree` [primitive] set or clear the worktree an agent is assigned to Use: updateAgentWorktree(db, agentId, worktreeId) // null clears

#### Class `agent-liveness`
- **getAgentLeaseTtlMs** `src/agents/livenessMode.ts#getAgentLeaseTtlMs` [primitive] read how long an agent lease lasts in network mode, in milliseconds Use: getAgentLeaseTtlMs() // from HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS
- **isNetworkLivenessMode** `src/agents/livenessMode.ts#isNetworkLivenessMode` [primitive] tell whether agents are tracked by leases (network mode) or by local PID Use: if (isNetworkLivenessMode()) { /* lease-based */ }
- **markAgentDead** `src/agents/markAgentDead.ts#markAgentDead` [primitive] mark an agent dead and release its claimed or started tasks back to pending Use: markAgentDead(db, agentId) // boolean
- **touchAgent** `src/agents/touchAgent.ts#touchAgent` [primitive] refresh an agent's last_seen_at lease and set it active Use: touchAgent(db, agentId) // boolean

#### Class `coordinator`
- **ensureCoordinator** `src/coordinator/spawn.ts#ensureCoordinator` [primitive] start the project coordinator as a detached process unless one is already running Use: ensureCoordinator({ dataDir, ... }) // { spawned, pid? }
- **getCoordinatorStatus** `src/coordinator/spawn.ts#getCoordinatorStatus` [primitive] report whether the coordinator is running and its pid Use: getCoordinatorStatus({ dataDir, ... }) // { running, pid? }
- **runCoordinator** `src/coordinator/index.ts#runCoordinator` [primitive] run the per-project coordinator loop, taking its lock and exiting if another one holds it Use: runCoordinator({ ...CoordinatorConfig })
